text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yesterday, I received some pickled vegetables from my hometown, and as I was eating them, I felt strangely uplifted.
choice_data_list: Probably because it was such a heartfelt gift.
Probably because it was such a heartfelt gift.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That must be it. It was a reminder of all the support I receive from back home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I've got a feeling that I'm gonna run well in my next race. I'll win this one—I promise.
Seeing Oguri Cap so motivated gives me high hopes for the upcoming race.
